profile.bio: Qi Xiong is a Lecturer at the School of Mathematics, Southwest Jiaotong University. She received her Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics from Nankai University in 2023. Her research interests include potential theory, nonlinear elliptic equations, and harmonic analysis. She is the principal investigator of a NSFC Young Scientists Fund project and a Sichuan Natural Science Foundation project.
